title: FraudNet-Synth
summary: A final-year academic project simulating four banks that jointly train a fraud classifier via federated learning (Flower/FedAvg), using client-adaptive synthetic data augmentation to help data-rich banks handle severe class imbalance in the ULB Credit Card Fraud dataset. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) to generate synthetic fraud rows and uses sdmetrics' QualityReport and NewRowSynthesis directly to gate augmentation quality and novelty.
